target: bench.sh ensure — a non-trivial merge conflict aborts and leaves the bench on its original commit
cmd: source "$FIXTURES/bench-repo.sh"; bench_fixture_setup --conflict; cd work; export FACTORY_BENCH_DIR="$PWD/../benches"; mkdir -p .agentic; echo '{"bench":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; bench_fixture_spec . pr-open feature 001; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/bench.sh"; ERR=$(bench_reconcile 2>&1 >/dev/null); CONTENT=$(cat "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/f.txt" 2>/dev/null); MERGING=no; git -C "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature" rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 && MERGING=yes; jq -n --arg content "$CONTENT" --arg err "$ERR" --arg merging "$MERGING" '{content: $content, err: $err, merging: $merging}'
